name: Episode Prewarm
description: Preloads the beginning of the next episode when playback reaches a configurable progress threshold.
overview: Asynchronously reads 1 MiB from the next episode with a persistent 6-hour cooldown per episode.

versions.changelog: Fix XML serialization of persisted per-episode cooldown state; store cooldown entries in an XML-serializable list.
Initial release: asynchronous next-episode preloading, per-episode 6-hour cooldown, configurable playback threshold, and runtime statistics.
